name: Supergraphic
description: A seventies wall supergraphic: five-stripe ribbons sweeping round in quarter turns and joining tile to tile, with a colored dot inside every bend.

code.style: --rule: ( --r: @p(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @var(--rib); transform: rotate(@var(--r)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -16%; top: -16%; width: 32%; height: 32%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: -16%; bottom: -16%; width: 32%; height: 32%; border-radius: 50%; background: @lp(); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --rib: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 33%, var(--color1) 33% 40%, var(--color2) 40% 47%, var(--color3) 47% 53%, var(--color2) 53% 60%, var(--color1) 60% 67%, transparent 67%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 33%, var(--color1) 33% 40%, var(--color2) 40% 47%, var(--color3) 47% 53%, var(--color2) 53% 60%, var(--color1) 60% 67%, transparent 67%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
